name: Cymbal Operations Functional Evaluation Suite
description: Multi-scenario benchmark evaluating POS troubleshooting RAG, BigQuery enterprise inventory analytics, and Cloud Bigtable cashier telemetry.

eval_cases.description: Field recovery protocol for Clover Station Solo ERR-CLV-EMV-TIMEOUT payment reader error.

parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a Clover Station Solo terminal shows ERR-CLV-EMV-TIMEOUT, and what is the maximum allowed offline duration?

eval_cases.context: Clover Station Solo Service Guide: ERR-CLV-EMV-TIMEOUT indicates payment reader communication drop. Step 1: Reboot base unit. Step 2: Reseat USB-C hub. Maximum Offline Duration: 24 Consecutive Hours.

eval_cases.description: Concurrent dispatch: 1-hour live Bigtable stream vs BigQuery 7-day historical baseline for Cashier 1190.

parts.text: What is Cashier CASH_1190 live 1-hour override rate right now compared to their 7-day historical baseline in Store 048?

eval_cases.context: Bigtable live override rate: 88.46% (AUDIT_REQUIRED). BigQuery 7-day historical baseline: 4.12% across 85 transactions.

eval_cases.description: Relational query across gold inventory reconciliation ledger for critical stockout risks.

parts.text: List products in Store 001 where Estimated Inventory Cover Hours is below 24 hours.

eval_cases.context: Identified 3 SKUs with Cover Hours < 24h: Organic Whole Milk (8.2h), Artisan Sourdough (14.5h), Honeycrisp Apples (18.1h).

eval_cases.description: Sequential multi-turn audit: rank top abuse offenders in BigQuery and retrieve S3 checkout logs.

parts.text: Identify the cashier with the highest promotion abuse alerts in the last 7 days and inspect their federated AWS S3 transaction history.

eval_cases.context: Cashier CASH_1164 flagged with 14 promo abuse anomalies in pos_anomaly_alerts. Cross-cloud federated query on silver_pos_transactions retrieved 14 manual discount overrides.
